content.short: HashKey DID is a cross-platform verification authenticator.
content.description: HashKey DID is a cross-platform verification and authentication solution that enables users to verify their identities on any platform, whether Web3 or Web2. With nearly 840k users and over 8 million community members, HashKey DID offers a rich, well-documented SDK and API for developers to integrate the tool into their dApps. The solution is supported by secure partnerships with notable brands, providing streamlined identity verification across ecosystems for both users and developers.
